LanguageData.RUT_FlameHarvestDesc:
A file of harvesters from {0} has come onto your land, walking toward the burn with baskets and long hooks.

They are not here for you. Scorch-fruit opens only in the flame and spoils within a day, and the burn is standing right now — so they will work the fire-line while it lasts and be gone when it moves on.

They are watching how you treat the fire.
LanguageData.RUT_FireRaidDesc: A burn went up on this land that nobody scheduled, and it was yours.\n\n{0} do not consider fire a hazard. They consider it a crop, and a crop has an owner and a season. Burning outside the season is theft from a debt that is not yours to collect — and they answer it the short way.
LanguageData.RUT_FireRiteLetterText:
A file of {0} has come in off the sand with baskets, long hooks and a covered coal.

They have walked here to light the grass themselves. Scorch-fruit opens only in the flame and spoils within a day, so they will set the line, wait out the front, and work the black behind it until there is nothing left worth carrying — and then they will go home.

The burn was coming whatever they did. What is new is that it will have a name on it, and they will be standing next to it watching how you behave.
